name: GEO-bench-highres2x
description: A benchmark for image super-resolution on geospatial / remote-sensing imagery (2x upscaling). It measures how well models restore high-frequency details and preserve geospatial structures in high-resolution satellite/ aerial images. Evaluation focuses on reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.
reputation: A specialized remote-sensing super-resolution benchmark with modest adoption in geospatial ML research.
